blockchain.title: Timing the bitcoin market is exciting but nearly impossible. Here's why
blockchain.excerpt: A historical analysis of bitcoin price performance from 2010 through 2026 demonstrates that the vast majority of the asset's annual returns occur during a tiny fraction of the calendar year.

blockchain.title: Ancient Bitcoin Wallet That Turned $120 Into $3 Million Wakes Up
blockchain.excerpt: At least four more decade-old wallets moved a combined $15.7 million between Aug. 29 and Sept. 4, with one batch of coins sent to Coinbase in a likely sign of a sale.
